notes.ACTION_ACCEPTANCE_CONFLICT: 409 with `action_id`: this recommendation key was already accepted (by a different command or idempotency key). Treat as 'already accepted' and follow `action_id`; it is not a failure of the existing Action.
notes.ACTION_ALREADY_APPLIED: 409 on apply with a new key after APPLIED: nothing was attempted and no FAILED event was written; `applied_event_id` names the APPLIED event.
notes.FAILED: A FAILED event is an attempt only. The application stays PENDING (or APPLIED); an identical retry returns the stored FAILED event (`replayed: true`); a fresh idempotency key may attempt again.
notes.PRIOR_ACTION_UNRESOLVED: State and typed 409 on accept. While an earlier reserve-trial-1 Action on this Finding is unresolved (application pending, including failed attempts, or applied with verification pending), a new key is held: `state` = PRIOR_ACTION_UNRESOLVED, `proposal` null, `prior_action_block` / `unavailable` name `blocking_action_id`, `origin_finding_revision_id` and `links`; `system_demo_capability.allowed` is false. The current-basis result is `live_status` (AVAILABLE on the recorded clock, FOUNDATION_BASIS_STALE on the served clock): show it as a separate live reason, never as an Accept. An identical retry of the existing accepted key still returns its Action.
notes.application_basis: `application_basis.current_foundation_revision_id` is the Foundation revision covering `covers_instant` (the read time), not the revision covering the command's `effective_from`, which the server checks under the Site lock. A Foundation change dated between the two, or recorded after the apply's server time (S1 FOUNDATION_CLOCK_BEHIND, `foundation_code`), yields 409 ACTION_FOUNDATION_STALE + FAILED: re-read and retry with a new idempotency key.
notes.prior_actions: D-2026-10-15-s601-reopen. Every recommendation read carries `prior_actions.items`: each Action on the canonical Finding (any revision) with its own `origin.finding_revision_id`/`revision_no`, `origin.is_selected_revision`, `application.state`, `outcome.state`, `unresolved` and `links.action`. Never relabel an earlier Action as the selected revision's.
notes.selectors: `event_id` selects the exact event and its (recorded_at, id) prefix; `recorded_at` selects every event recorded through that server instant. Both together: 422 ACTION_SELECTOR_CONFLICT.
notes.volatile: IDs, digests and action codes differ per run; tests compare after replacing UUIDs, 64-hex digests and ACT-nnnnnn codes with placeholders.
